sn22.26:1.2: me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattassa sato etad ahosi || || 4
sn22.26:1.3: Ko nu kho rūpassa assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ || ||
sn22.26:1.7: Ko viññāṇassa assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇan ti || || 5
sn22.26:1.9: Yaṃ kho rūpam paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ || ayaṃ rūpassa assādo || ||
sn22.26:1.10: Yaṃ rūpam aniccaṃ dukkham vipariṇāmadhammaṃ || ayaṃ rūpassa ādīnavo || ||
sn22.26:1.11: Yo rūpasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgapahānaṃ || idaṃ rūpassa nissaraṇaṃ || 7
sn22.26:1.16: Yaṃ saṅkhāre paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ || ayaṃ saṅkhārānam assādo || ||
sn22.26:1.17: Yaṃ saṅkhārā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā || ayaṃ saṅkhārānam ādīnavo || ||
sn22.26:1.18: Yo saṅkhāresu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgapahānaṃ || idaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ || || 10
sn22.26:1.19: Yaṃ viññāṇam paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ || ayaṃ viññāṇassa assādo || ||
sn22.26:1.20: Yaṃ viññāṇam aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ || ayaṃ viññāṇassa ādīnavo || ||
sn22.26:1.21: Yo viññāṇasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgapahānaṃ || idaṃ viññāṇassa nissaraṇaṃ || || 11
sn22.26:2.1: Yāva kīvañcāham bhikkhave imesam pañcannam upādānakkhandhānam evam assādañ ca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañ ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābhaññāsiṃ || neva tāvāham bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhim abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ || || 12
sn22.26:2.2: Yato ca khvāham bhikkhave imesam pañcannam upādānakkhandhānam evam assādañ ca assādato ādīnavañ ca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtam abbhaññāsiṃ ||
sn22.26:2.3: athāham bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhim abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ || || 13
sn22.26:2.5: Akuppā me cetovimutti ayam antimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavoti || || 1-2
